competencies.statement: The learner can conduct keyword research and competitive analysis to inform an SEO plan.
competencies.description: Produces a keyword/competitor analysis that guides targeting.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement on-page and off-page SEO strategies.
competencies.description: Applies title/meta/structure and link-building tactics correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can explain and apply major search-engine ranking factors.
competencies.description: Identifies which factors affect ranking in a given scenario.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop, optimize, and distribute content across digital platforms.
competencies.description: Plans and adapts a content piece for multiple channels.

competencies.statement: The learner can use a content management system (CMS) effectively to publish and manage content.
competencies.description: Publishes/organizes content and settings in a CMS.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply copywriting best practices for digital marketing.
competencies.description: Writes clear, persuasive on-brand marketing copy.

competencies.statement: The learner can build and manage PPC campaigns (e.g., Google Ads, social media ads).
competencies.description: Structures campaigns, ad groups, bids, and targeting.

competencies.statement: The learner can run A/B tests and conversion-rate optimization on campaigns.
competencies.description: Designs a valid A/B test and interprets the result.

competencies.statement: The learner can use analytics tools to track ROI and PPC campaign performance.
competencies.description: Reads spend/return metrics and judges performance.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop and execute organic and paid social media campaigns.
competencies.description: Plans and runs a coordinated organic+paid social effort.

competencies.statement: The learner can engage an audience and monitor brand sentiment on social channels.
competencies.description: Responds appropriately and tracks sentiment signals.

competencies.statement: The learner can use analytics tools to measure social campaign effectiveness.
competencies.description: Selects and interprets the right social metrics.

competencies.statement: The learner can design and optimize an email marketing campaign.
competencies.description: Builds an email campaign with a clear goal and structure.

competencies.statement: The learner can segment audiences and personalize email content.
competencies.description: Defines segments and tailors content to them.

competencies.statement: The learner can analyze email campaign performance and improve deliverability.
competencies.description: Reads open/click/bounce metrics and improves deliverability.

competencies.statement: The learner can use Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other reporting tools.
competencies.description: Navigates analytics tools to answer a measurement question.

competencies.statement: The learner can track key performance indicators (KPIs) and user behavior.
competencies.description: Chooses appropriate KPIs and reads behavior reports.

competencies.statement: The learner can interpret analytics data to optimize marketing strategy.
competencies.description: Turns a data finding into a strategy adjustment.

competencies.statement: The learner can conduct usability testing and user-experience analysis.
competencies.description: Runs a usability check and identifies UX issues.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement strategies to improve website conversion rates.
competencies.description: Proposes a change likely to lift conversion, with rationale.

competencies.statement: The learner can use heatmaps, A/B testing, and user feedback to enhance the digital experience.
competencies.description: Combines qualitative/quantitative signals to improve UX.

competencies.statement: The learner can use CRM platforms to support customer engagement.
competencies.description: Manages contacts/activities in a CRM to drive engagement.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply marketing automation and personalization tools.
competencies.description: Builds an automated, personalized marketing flow.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement chatbots, AI-driven insights, and emerging marketing technologies.
competencies.description: Applies an emerging martech capability to a task.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply data-privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) to marketing activities.
competencies.description: Identifies compliant handling of data in a scenario.

competencies.statement: The learner can ensure ethical marketing practices and compliance with advertising policies.
competencies.description: Flags an unethical/non-compliant practice and corrects it.
